article.headline: IRS Raises Income Thresholds for 2027 Tax Brackets to Combat Bracket Creep
article.summary: The IRS has increased federal income tax brackets and standard deductions for 2027 to account for inflation, helping taxpayers avoid higher tax rates.
article.body:
The standard deduction for married couples filing jointly will rise to $33,200 in 2027, up from $32,200 in 2026. Single filers will see their deduction increase to $16,600 from $16,100, according to data provided by the IRS. These adjustments represent a shift in the income ranges that determine how much of an individual's earnings are taxed at each level.

These updates are critical for taxpayers navigating the rising costs of daily living. By adjusting income thresholds annually based on the consumer price index, the IRS aims to prevent "bracket creep." This phenomenon occurs when cost-of-living pay raises push earners into higher tax tiers, even if their actual purchasing power has not increased. Higher thresholds ensure that individuals can earn more in 2027 without being automatically subjected to higher marginal rates.

While the income ranges for the seven federal tax brackets have shifted, the actual tax rates remain constant at 10%, 12%, 22%, 24%, 32%, 35%, and 37%. The highest rate of 37% applies to individual taxable income exceeding $661,375 and $793,650 for married couples filing jointly. Because the U.S. system is progressive, these rates apply only to the specific portion of income falling within each designated tier rather than the entirety of an earner's income.

In addition to brackets and standard deductions, the IRS has increased thresholds for several other provisions for 2027, including long-term capital gains, the estate and gift tax exemption, and eligibility for the earned income tax credit. Taxpayers will utilize these new figures when filing their federal income tax returns in 2028.

article.headline: Brighton storms into Madrid seeking European glory against struggling Getafe side
article.summary: Brighton faces Getafe on matchday three of the Conference League following a strong start to their domestic campaign.
article.body: Getafe suffered a heavy 5-2 defeat at home against Swiss club Lugano on matchday two, highlighting defensive struggles in their own stadium. Conversely, Brighton arrives with momentum after securing a 1-0 win at Manchester City last Saturday, marking their 10th clean sheet across all competitions this season. The Seagulls have proven formidable, winning nine of their 15 matches this term while losing only twice. Their Premier League form is equally impressive, currently boasting the highest goal tally in the division with 24 goals scored. For fans, this fixture offers a clear contrast between an in-form Premier League outfit and a Getafe side that has struggled for consistency, winning only five of their 16 matches this season. Brighton has taken four points from their first two matches in the current league phase, while Getafe holds a single point from an opening draw against Universitatea Craiova. Brighton manager Fabian Hurzeler is expected to rotate his squad for the Thursday encounter in Madrid. Injury concerns persist for the visitors, with Femi Azeez, Evan Ferguson, and Zadok Yohanna ruled out, while Pascal Struijk and Ferdi Kadioglu remain doubts. Getafe will be without the trio of Christantus Uche, Juanmi, and Zaid Romero, although key players Kiko Femenia and Borja Mayoral are expected to feature. Despite a recent 3-1 league victory over Sevilla, Getafe remains under pressure after their heavy European home loss earlier this month. The match serves as a pivotal test for both clubs as they navigate the league phase of the UEFA Conference League.
